verdict.rationale: Users can delegate agent creation, configuration, and management to an AI assistant through natural language. However, that assistant is external (Claude or another MCP client via the hosted MCP server, or a coding assistant using the agents skill), not one built into the ElevenAgents dashboard. The 'assistant' mentioned elsewhere in the docs is the customer-facing agent being built, not an in-product helper. Missing for 10: a native in-dashboard AI assistant or copilot, documentation of what tasks it can perform in-product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
